tickets.title: A land-repair replacement worker does not re-claim a partially landed flake ticket
tickets.what: Milestone review j07ff6cea6f157c6c finding 2 (run q69ce631dff1b534b). `dispatchLandRepair` copies the original ticket into the replacement job (`src/mcp/dispatch/orchestrator.ts` ~155-158, ~909-925, ~1855-1881). When the source report leaves an acceptance item under Not done and the replacement fixes a failing gate, the completed partial land belongs to the source (`src/mcp/land-records.ts` ~75-97). `src/mcp/flake-admission.ts` ~65-77 releases the source's claim, but the settled replacement has no land receipt under its own ID, so it adds the same ticket back to `claimedTickets`; `hud_tickets ready` then omits it (`src/mcp/local-tickets.ts` ~489-491) until retention and a follow-up queue cannot pick it up. Treat a land-repair job as part of its owning land attempt, not an independent dispatch. Verify line numbers at HEAD first.

acceptance.text: Test: admission stays blocked while the land repair runs and reopens after the confirmed partial land, with both the source and repair job receipts retained
hud_tickets ready lists the partially landed flake ticket after the repair settles

tickets.title: Fold graph helpers onto the owning node
tickets.what: Review jbce97a18f5eb2838 #2: a graph land node reuses its input worker's job ID (`src/collectors/execution-runs.ts` ~1227); the fold in `src/collectors/execution.ts` ~473 picks the last node per ID, so `build`'s helpers show on waiting `publish`. Prefer the owning (non-land) node. Drop the tautological `.length === 4` assert in `tests/unit/execution-runs.test.mjs` ~954.
